title: Classify DAO Transit E as semantic only after authenticated replay
description: P1 protocol correctness: DaoOriginValidator.validate() currently rejects any Transit option whose flags octet is nonzero during its pre-key structural pass (the len-not-20 or data[0]-not-zero check). In the current profile, E=1 is unsupported, but spec/05-routing.md sections 8.6-8.8 and dao_origin_signature.json classify it as a semantic rejection after signature and replay; only exact Transit length and framing belong to the structural stage. A lower-sequence signed DAO with E=1 is therefore reported malformed before replay, violating the mandatory decision order. Restrict structural validation to exact length and framing, reject E and reserved flags during detached semantic parsing, and execute both fresh and lower-sequence E=1 vectors against production stage and reason behavior.
